registers.name: CONTROL
registers.description: Control register. Bit 0 stores ENABLE. Bit 1 is a write pulse for SAMPLE_START and always reads back as 0. Bit 2 stores IRQ_ENABLE. Bit 3 is a write pulse for ALERT_CLEAR and always reads back as 0. Other bits read as 0.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Master enable for periodic sampling generation.

fields.name: SAMPLE_START
fields.description: Writing 1 generates a one-cycle sample_req pulse. Readback is always 0.

fields.name: IRQ_ENABLE
fields.description: Enables alert_irq when any IRQ_STATUS bit is set.

fields.name: ALERT_CLEAR
fields.description: Writing 1 clears alert_status and STATUS.alert_pending. Readback is always 0.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Status register. Bit 0 sample_done is sticky until cleared by IRQ_CLEAR bit 1. Bit 1 alert_pending mirrors latched alert_status until cleared by ALERT_CLEAR or IRQ_CLEAR bit 0. Bit 2 adc_valid_seen is sticky until reset. Bit 3 busy is high while a requested sample is pending. Other bits read as 0.

fields.name: sample_done
fields.description: Sticky indication that at least one adc_valid completion occurred since last clear.

fields.name: alert_pending
fields.description: Mirrors latched alert_status until cleared by ALERT_CLEAR or IRQ_CLEAR bit 0.

fields.name: adc_valid_seen
fields.description: Sticky after the first adc_valid sample until reset.

fields.name: busy
fields.description: High while a requested sample is pending.

registers.name: THRESHOLD
registers.description: Threshold compare register. threshold_code is stored in bits [11:0]. Upper bits read as 0.

fields.name: threshold_code
fields.description: Filtered temperature threshold used for alert comparison.

registers.name: LATEST_TEMP
registers.description: Latest filtered temperature register. latest_temp is reported in bits [11:0]. Upper bits read as 0.

fields.name: latest_temp
fields.description: Latest filtered temperature code from the two-sample moving-average path.

registers.name: SAMPLE_COUNT
registers.description: Completed sample count. This register is preserved by ALERT_CLEAR and IRQ_CLEAR and is only cleared by reset. Width is 16 bits.

fields.name: sample_count
fields.description: Number of completed adc_valid samples captured since reset.

registers.name: IRQ_STATUS
registers.description: Sticky interrupt status register. Bit 0 alert. Bit 1 sample_done. Other bits read as 0.

fields.name: alert
fields.description: Sticky alert interrupt source, set when filtered temperature exceeds threshold.

fields.name: sample_done
fields.description: Sticky sample-complete interrupt source, set on each adc_valid completion.

registers.name: IRQ_CLEAR
registers.description: Write-one-to-clear register. Writing bit 0 clears IRQ_STATUS.alert and alert_status. Writing bit 1 clears IRQ_STATUS.sample_done and STATUS.sample_done. Upper bits are ignored. Readback is not required and may read as 0.

fields.name: clear_alert
fields.description: Write 1 to clear irq_status_alert and alert_status.

fields.name: clear_sample_done
fields.description: Write 1 to clear irq_status_sample_done and STATUS.sample_done.
